project.title: Microbial community analysis in simulated premise plumbing systems
project.description: This study investigates the microbial community composition of water samples collected from a simulated premise plumbing system. High-throughput sequencing was applied to characterize microbial diversity and community structure under controlled experimental conditions. The resulting sequencing data provide insights into microbial dynamics in premise plumbing environments.
